main.description: Creates a mute relationship for the specified account. If a mute already exists for the account, it is updated in place: the stored kinds are replaced with the kinds in this request. Mutes are private in Bluesky. Requires auth.

kinds.description: Scope the mute to specific kinds of content from the account. Omit for a full mute. Always send the full desired set: repeat calls replace the stored kinds rather than adding to them.
